Carried to the S6 freeze. The freeze states two limits of the failure readback: it can leave out an unreadable directory's entries, and it cannot tell an exited, unreaped process from a live process whose identity is not established. In either case the outcome stays UNKNOWN, and nothing is sent. The code change is carried to a later implementation phase.

The installation inventory, taken before and after, detects any write. Moving the check to each tool's first statement is carried to a later implementation phase.
